g.text: type: SPEC status: Draft version: "1.0" owner: "@rix"
# Room Export — Product Specification
## References · ## Problem Statement · ## User Stories
## Requirements
| ID | Requirement | Priority |
| FR-1 | Export ledger as CSV | Must Have |
| FR-2 | Filter by date range (room TZ) | Must Have |
| NFR-1| 100k rows stream < 5s | Should |
## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] CSV opens in Excel/Sheets with correct encoding
## Non-Goals (Out of Scope)
- PDF export · scheduled exports
## Open Questions
- [ ] Include soft-deleted entries?
## Dependencies · ## Appendix
# IDs are stable anchors — sequential, no gaps. Code will point
# at them forever: @see spec.md [FR-1] [NFR-1]
# status Draft → Approved freezes the spec & unlocks design;
# scope edits bump version and demote downstream
FRONTMATTER → STATUS PILLS
Status, version, owner become pills in the
previewer title bar; Draft/Approved drives the
stepper state and which actions unlock.
FR TABLE → LIVING ANCHORS
Hover [FR-1] anywhere in code → the row previews
inline. CodeLens opens the spec. Analytics counts
which FRs still have no code behind them.
SECTIONS → QUALITY PULSE
Every section is graded live — Strategy, Structure,
Clarity, Completeness. Weak spots get a Coach
suggestion with its own targeted fix command.
OPEN QUESTIONS → NUDGES
Unresolved questions surface as blockers in the
previewer and journal nudges prompt you to
capture the answer when it lands in chat.
WHOLE DOC → ACTION STRIP
With this file active, chat's strip reads:
Refine · Author · Validate · Review · Approve
— Approve blocked while Critical issues remain.
